q_001.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

q_002.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A'

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_disposition_count FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER'

q_004.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payments), 2) AS average_monthly_payment FROM loan

q_005.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients_count
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A11 > 10000

q_006.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.A3 = 'Prague'

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM trans WHERE account_id = 1 AND substr(date, 1, 2) = '97'

q_008.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district d ON account.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER' AND d.A3 = 'south Moravia'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY owner_count DESC

q_009.sql:
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan DESC
LIMIT 5

q_010.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS running_good_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND c.gender = 'M'
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id AND dist.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
WHERE l.status = 'C'
